text_block_list.text:
It's time for dance lessons... and yet, 
I'm at the arcade with Seiun Sky.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought, looks like we can 
practice with this dance game here~.
choice_data_list: I wonder if it's really effective?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Totally, totally~! You're sure to get a 
feel for the rhythm!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: All right, let's try dancing right away~♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Move like this... and then like this!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's tougher than you'd think. It might 
actually take more stamina than a regular 
lesson.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how's our score looking? Aren't we 
doing pretty darn well~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Outside the rankings... Hmph. Well, it's 
just a game anyway~.
choice_data_list:
Just so you know, this is still a lesson, 
alright?

Just so we're clear, this is still a 
lesson, okay?

text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky's play continued for a while 
after that, but—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... You've really improved a 
lot. This time... you might've made the 
leaderboard.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: How is it, how is it~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, still no good~? Isn't 1st place 
'TEIO' way too strong?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Memorize the song... focus on the weak 
spots... No, how can I improve even more 
efficiently...?
choice_data_list: Push just a little harder and we can win!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please~. There's no way I'd ever get 
serious.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So with that, we're done for today~. Man, 
I'm beat, I'm beat~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I danced so much even though it's totally 
not like me, and now I'm drenched in 
sweat~.

Afterward, there were scattered sightings 
of Seiun Sky at the arcade...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm really not working hard at all. 
I'm not good with that sort of thing.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, you know. The game itself was 
well made, so—"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
With a bit of dance practice, you'd 
probably beat the top score in no time.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if that's what you really want, 
Trainer, I suppose I could keep you 
company?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's wrap this up quick before 
we draw a crowd~.

And so, in a rare turn of events, Seiun 
Sky practiced her dancing right up until 
curfew.
